pre_condition: func is a non-empty string containing source code lines. GRANULARITY is a positive integer constant defined in the enclosing scope.
post_condition: Returns an ordered list of block strings, each a contiguous segment of func, such that the concatenation of all blocks in returned order reconstructs func. When the total line count of func does not exceed GRANULARITY, the result is a single-element list containing func. Otherwise, every block except possibly the last contains exactly GRANULARITY lines. When fewer than 2*GRANULARITY lines remain at the end, those remaining lines form the final block regardless of whether its line count reaches GRANULARITY. Each original line of func appears exactly once and in its original order across the returned list.
